name: HDFS 3101
title: Infant and Toddler Development
description: Study of children from birth to three years from an integrated human development perspective; biological and social contextual influences.
requirement_description: HDFS 2100, or PSYC 2400; HDFS 2004, or NURS 3205, or PSYC 2100Q, or SOCI 3201, which may be taken concurrently; open to juniors or higher. May not be taken out of sequence after passing HDFS 4181.
